Pocket TTS by Kyutai
Code: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts
Runtime: official PyPI pocket-tts 3.3.0, MIT (LICENSE).
Model: https://huggingface.co/kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning
English 2026-09_2 weights, revision 575d14372df89a4534bcb989870a34e77544b09f
Model license: CC BY 4.0 (CC-BY-4.0.txt).
Tokenizer revision: 00eac05ed3d16bdc3f6b5d598874019c34a89214
Voice embedding revision: ab248779e0718743c013e20b2d812ace7c8f4bf7
Config: upstream commit 9aa7a7f0e52a4cd81bcf8a0fc7c981cdc6d11e53

Weights and embeddings are unchanged. QuietSelection loads explicit local files,
uses CPU float32, temperature 0.3, one decode step, two inference threads, keeps
only selected profiles, disables voice cloning and blocks network/file writes
in the worker. Two eager-only runtime changes are applied reproducibly by
Prepare-PocketRuntime.py: omit the torch.compiler.disable decorator on the
attention-mask helper and omit einops' Dynamo registration. This prevents unused
compiler disk-cache initialization; tensor computations are unchanged.
Our adapter adds bounded text
segmentation, cancellation/draining, private PCM IPC and WSOLA speed adjustment.
Source text and generated audio are not saved.

Voice source attribution: https://huggingface.co/kyutai/tts-voices
See VOICES-UPSTREAM.md and voice-sources.json for each original recording.
Alba: Alba MacKenna, casual.wav, CC BY 4.0.
Anna, Azelma, Charles, Eponine, Eve, Fantine, George, Jane, Mary, Michael,
Paul, Vera: VCTK, University of Edinburgh, CC BY 4.0.
Cosette: Expresso dataset, Meta, CC BY-NC 4.0, NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY.
Jean: EARS dataset, CC BY-NC 4.0, NON-COMMERCIAL ONLY.
Marius, Javert: Unmute Voice Donation Project, CC0.
Bill Boerst, Caro Davy, Peter Yearsley, Stuart Bell: Voice-Zero / LibriVox, CC0.

The model's CC BY license does not supersede the individual voice-source terms.
All are suitable for the requested personal offline evaluation. Commercial
redistribution/use must exclude the non-commercial profiles or obtain permission.

The inference-only dependencies are pinned in runtime.json; package license
files remain alongside each library in pocket-runtime/*.dist-info/licenses.
CPU PyTorch, NumPy, sentencepiece, PyYAML and typing_extensions reuse the existing
application runtimes, with their existing notices. No server or cloud API is used.
